summary: Gabelli Global Small & Mid Cap Value Trust filed an 8-K reporting that Trustee, Chairman and CIO Mario J. Gabelli was hospitalized after a medical incident on March 19, 2026. GAMCO Investors, Inc. implemented its succession plan on March 22, 2026, naming Christopher J. Marangi as President; day-to-day operations now led by co-CEO Douglas R. Jamieson and Marangi. The Gabelli Value team Co-CIOs Kevin V. Dreyer and Christopher J. Marangi lead the portfolio management team during Gabelli's absence. The filing does not contain any acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC event. The abrupt medical event triggering a succession plan is the key event, not routine leadership disclosure.
